mechanism.base: Fire gives birth to earth, the old texts say: what burns comes down at last as ash, and ash settles into soil. Nothing bright is lost entirely. The flame that danced for an evening feeds the field for a generation, warmth pressed down into ground that will hold seeds long after the light is gone.
mechanism.catalyst_turn: Run thin, the fire leaves no ash: heat and light, nothing banked, nothing built from the burning. Your chart asks you to settle some flame. Teach it, write it, found it.
mechanism.friction_turn: Run heavy, every spark gets pressed into a monument: output hardening faster than it can live. Let some fires just be fires. Not every flame must found something.

function.definition_catalyst:
Earth is your Expression, and as a catalyst, it is your heat becoming things that last: lessons taught, systems written down, gatherings that become traditions. You are at your best converting enthusiasm into something others can stand on.

The recipe people ask for, the onboarding doc that outlived your job, the Friday dinner that somehow became an institution among your friends: that is this energy working. Your excitement keeps turning into furniture other lives get to use.

Enthusiasm fades, structure remembers. After every burst of inspiration, spend one hour making it hold: a document, a recipe, a repeatable plan. Host the gathering twice and it becomes tradition. Write down the thing you keep explaining.
function.definition_friction:
Earth is your Expression, and as a friction, it is making monuments out of moments: every idea formalized, every project turned permanent, output hardening while your energy thins.

Every hobby has a spreadsheet, every dinner a theme, every passing thought a folder. The instinct to make things last has started embalming them instead, and maintaining past enthusiasms now crowds out having new ones.

Some warmth is meant to be spent, never stored. Let the next good idea stay a conversation. Retire one system you maintain out of habit. Pour your building energy into the single structure that actually matters this year, and let the rest be evenings.

candidates.cta_verdict: Your heat leaves you as something solid, homes, habits, made things, and people trust what you build longer than what you say.

__ore.retired_bonds_dip: People inhabit what you express: your warmth reaches them as belonging.
__ore.retired_fn_body: The Voice is your expression function: the gate where inner heat becomes outer fact. With Earth running it, expression in you builds rather than dazzles: lessons, systems, homes, traditions warm to the touch. You speak in things that outlast the saying. Feed it steadily and your warmth becomes infrastructure, the kind of expression people live inside for years.
__ore.retired_base_personal: Your core is Fire, and Fire feeds Earth: ash becomes soil. Whatever your heat pours itself into becomes your Expression, the channel where your burning turns to ground others stand on. Every lesson taught, every custom kept warm, every gathering hosted is your flame settling into something lasting. Light shows. Soil stays.

backlog_dips_tg_pattern.mind: Teaching is how your thinking settles: explain it once and you own it.
